garrison_note: K3 per-site plan (+30 village for op 4); members added since are not in it (ASSUMED)

1 grid: junction steps (a road joining t.note: each joining road ends on a 12 m level landing at the junction's level; the step is where the earlier road's band climbs away from it

3 roads: dirt grade <= 14 %.method: measured on the points as handed over: point to point, and over every stretch of 10 m and 20 m along them

3 roads: one connected net per island.reading: the rule binds sites with a vehicle approach; where the purpose map gives no site one, every site the net reaches is on ONE net per island and the rest are foot / boat / air (their foot links are in the plan)

3 roads: nothing built within 3 m of a r.town_note: town houses are measured from their walls (your grader's footprints of the K6 layouts) to the road edge, with no exemption at the street ends

4-F Drain Locks: W along the bank from 4-M2 once it falls (269 deg)
4-M2 Drain Rail Bridge: SSW past 4-01 to the south gate (190 deg)
over the 4-06 causeway to the north gate (309 deg)
4-M3 Central Salient: SSW past 4-11 from the Rail Bridge (214 deg)
4-M4 Barge Quay: by player boat through the lock once 4-F falls

checks_suddra.method: measured on the plan's road points (5 m apart or closer) after raising any point under +0.5 m to +0.5 m; bend radius from the circle through each point and the points 5 m before and after it; turns within 12 m of a road end (where it leaves the net or a pad edge) are listed apart as junction turns, NOT as passes
